meetup.title: Meetup Safety Tips
meetup.subtitle: This is a local marketplace — every deal is completed in person. Keep these tips in mind.

tips.publicPlace: Meet in a busy, public place — markets, mosques, or shopping areas are safest.
tips.bringFriend: Bring a friend, or tell someone where you're going and who you're meeting.
tips.inspectItem: Inspect the item carefully before paying — make sure it works as described.
tips.noAdvancePayment: Never pay in advance or send money before seeing the item in person.
tips.trustInstincts: Trust your instincts — if something feels wrong, walk away.
tips.reportSuspicious: Report suspicious users or listings so we can keep the community safe.
